name: Jiragen Drone na Noma a Afirka: Dokokin Sufurin Jiragen Sama da Lasisi
objectives: Don ƙasarku, nemo ƙa'idojin drone, ma'aunai da jadawalin kuɗaɗe na hukumar sufurin jiragen sama, da faɗin sunan kowane mataki na dokar drone, tare da hanyoyin haɗi da ranar da kuka duba

Idan aka ba ku aikin drone na noma na kasuwanci a Kenya, jera rajista, lasisoshi, takardun shaida da izinin KCAA da wataƙila zai buƙata, kuna faɗin ƙa'idojin da suka fito daga ciki, da cewa dole a duba kuɗaɗen yanzu da sababbin dokoki

Idan aka ba ku nauyin drone da aikin da aka shirya a Najeriya, rarraba drone ɗin da matakin haɗarin aikin a ƙarƙashin Sashe na 21, da jera iyakokin aiki da suka shafe shi, da rukunin nauyi da matakin haɗari daidai

Don kasuwancin ayyukan drone, tsara lasisoshin matuƙa da takardar shaidar mai gudanarwa da yake buƙata, da takardun da takardar shaidar ke nema, kuna raba izinin mutumin da ke tuƙawa da izinin kasuwancin

Idan aka ba ku aikin da ya ƙunshi feshi, BVLOS, tashi da dare ko filin jirgin sama, gane ƙarin izinin sufurin jiragen sama da na maganin ƙwari da yake buƙata, da waɗanda ke bayar da su, kafin ku yi tayin aikin ko ku tsara shi
Don kasuwancin drone ɗinku, gina fayil na bin doka da jadawalin sabuntawa da duba dokoki, da kowace takarda da ake buƙata a jere da matsayinta

chapters.name: Babi na 1: Dokar drone a Afirka

lessons.title: Darasi 1: Yadda aka gina dokar drone
lessons.text:
Darasi 1 cikin 6 · kusan minti 5
Manufa: Nemo da faɗin sunan matakan dokar drone da suka shafi ƙasarku.
Wannan darasi yana shirya ku don: Don ƙasarku, za ku iya nemo ƙa'idojin drone, ma'aunai da jadawalin kuɗaɗe na hukumar sufurin jiragen sama, da faɗin sunan kowane mataki na dokar drone, tare da hanyoyin haɗi da ranar da kuka duba.
Ƙasashe suna gina dokokin sufurin jiragen sama bisa ma'aunai na duniya daga ICAO, Hukumar Sufurin Jiragen Sama ta Duniya ta Majalisar Ɗinkin Duniya, amma kowace ƙasa tana rubuta dokar drone ɗinta kuma tana aiwatar da ita. Yawanci akwai dokar sufurin jiragen sama da majalisa ta zartar; ƙa'idojin drone da aka yi a ƙarƙashin wannan doka; ma'aunan aiwatarwa ko littattafan jagora masu cikakken bayanin fasaha; jadawalin kuɗaɗe; da sanarwa ko takardun umarni don yanayi na musamman.
Yawancin dokokin drone na zamani suna rarraba ayyuka bisa haɗari. Tashi mai ƙaramin haɗari (ƙaramin drone, ana ganinsa, ƙasa-ƙasa, nesa da mutane da filayen jirgi) yana da mafi sauƙin buƙatu. Tashi mai babban haɗari (drone masu nauyi, wuce gani, sama da mutane, kusa da filin jirgin sama, feshi ko jefa abubuwa) yana buƙatar ƙari: izini, masu gudanarwa masu takardar shaida, matuƙa masu lasisi, wani lokaci kuma jirgi mai takardar shaida.
Don nemo dokokin ƙasarku, ku je shafin intanet na hukumar sufurin jiragen sama ku nemi sashen da ake kira drones, UAS, RPAS ko unmanned aircraft (jiragen sama marasa matuƙi). Ku sauke ƙa'idojin, ma'aunan da jadawalin kuɗaɗe, ku rubuta ranar. Misalan hukumomi: KCAA (Kenya), NCAA (Najeriya), da hukumomin sufurin jiragen sama na Ghana, Rwanda, Uganda, Tanzania da Afirka ta Kudu.
Mataki-mataki:
- Ku buɗe shafin intanet na hukumar sufurin jiragen samanku.
- Ku nemo sashen drones / UAS / RPAS.
- Ku sauke ƙa'idojin, ma'aunan aiwatarwa da jadawalin kuɗaɗe.
- Ku rubuta ranar da sigar kowanne.
- Ku jera yadda dokokin ke rarraba ayyuka bisa haɗari.
Kalmomin da za ku sani:
- ICAO: Hukumar Sufurin Jiragen Sama ta Duniya, hukumar Majalisar Ɗinkin Duniya da ke kafa ma'aunan sufurin jiragen sama na duniya.
- Ƙa'idoji (regulations): dokokin da dole a bi, waɗanda aka yi a ƙarƙashin dokar majalisa.
- Ma'aunan aiwatarwa (implementing standards): cikakkun dokokin fasaha da ke bayanin yadda ake cika ƙa'idojin.
- Matakin haɗari (risk category): rukunin ayyuka masu kama da juna a haɗari da buƙatu.
Majiyoyi na hukuma:
- Hukumar Sufurin Jiragen Sama ta Kenya (KCAA): Jiragen sama marasa matuƙi (UAS)
- Hukumar Sufurin Jiragen Sama ta Najeriya (NCAA): Nig.CARs 2023 Sashe na 21, Jiragen drone (RPAS)
Gwada yanzu: Don ƙasarku, ku jera hukumar sufurin jiragen sama, suna da shekarar ƙa'idojin drone, ko akwai ma'aunan aiwatarwa da jadawalin kuɗaɗe, da ranar da kuka duba. Ku ajiye takardun a babban fayil ɗaya.
Yanzu za ku iya nemo matakan dokar drone a ƙasarku da ganin yadda suke rarraba ayyuka bisa haɗari.

check.q: Mene ne jadawalin kuɗaɗe a dokar drone?
options: Jerin izinin da ake da su da kuɗin kowanne
check.why: Jadawalin kuɗaɗe yana jera izinin da kuɗinsu, don haka yana nuna abin da ake da shi.

check.q: Kuna son dokokin drone na ƙasarku. A ina za ku fara dubawa?
options: Shafin intanet na hukumar sufurin jiragen sama, a sashen drones, UAS ko RPAS
check.why: Hukumar sufurin jiragen sama ta kowace ƙasa tana wallafa ƙa'idojin drone, ma'aunai da kuɗaɗenta.

lessons.title: Darasi 2: Kenya: KCAA da Ƙa'idojin UAS na 2020
lessons.text:
Darasi 2 cikin 6 · kusan minti 6
Manufa: Jera izinin Kenya da mai gudanar da drone na noma na kasuwanci zai iya buƙata.
Wannan darasi yana shirya ku don: Idan aka ba ku aikin drone na noma na kasuwanci a Kenya, za ku iya jera rajista, lasisoshi, takardun shaida da izinin KCAA da wataƙila zai buƙata, kuna faɗin ƙa'idojin da suka fito daga ciki, da cewa dole a duba kuɗaɗen yanzu da sababbin dokoki.
A Kenya, ana tafiyar da jiragen drone ƙarƙashin Civil Aviation (Unmanned Aircraft Systems) Regulations, 2020, waɗanda aka yi a ƙarƙashin Civil Aviation Act, 2013 (Dokar Sufurin Jiragen Sama), kuma KCAA ce ke kula da su. Shafin drone na KCAA yana kuma wallafa littafin ma'aunan aiwatarwa (Manual of Implementing Standards) da jadawalin kuɗaɗe, wato Civil Aviation (Regulatory Fees and Charges for Unmanned Aircraft Systems) Regulations, 2020.
Jadawalin kuɗaɗen yana nuna manyan izinin da ake da su: takardar izinin shigo da drone da rajistarsa; takardun shaidar cancantar tashi; Remote Air Operator Certificate (ROC) don masu gudanarwa; izinin ayyuka don Rukuni A da Rukunoni B da C; lasisoshi ga mutane, ciki har da lasisin ɗalibin matukin drone, lasisin matukin drone (RPL), da ƙarin cancanta kamar tashi wuce gani; da izini ga cibiyoyin horo da masu sake sayar da drone. KCAA tana jera masu ROC da cibiyoyin horo da aka amince da su a shafinta, kuma ana neman izini ta tsarin drone ɗinta na intanet.
Shafin KCAA yana kuma jera sababbin Ƙa'idojin Sufurin Jiragen Sama na Kenya da aka wallafa na 2026. Ku duba ko wani daga cikinsu yana canja dokokin drone kafin ku dogara da na 2020, kuma ku duba kuɗaɗen yanzu a ranar da kuka nema.
Kalmomin da za ku sani:
- KCAA: Hukumar Sufurin Jiragen Sama ta Kenya, wadda ke kula da jiragen drone a Kenya.
- ROC: Remote Air Operator Certificate: izinin KCAA ga ƙungiya ko kamfani don gudanar da ayyukan drone.
- SRPL / RPL: lasisin ɗalibin matukin drone / lasisin matukin drone.
- Takardar shaidar cancantar tashi (certificate of airworthiness): tabbaci na hukuma cewa jirgi ya dace kuma yana da aminci don tashi.
Majiyoyi na hukuma:
- Hukumar Sufurin Jiragen Sama ta Kenya (KCAA): Jiragen sama marasa matuƙi (UAS)
- Kenya Law: The Civil Aviation (Unmanned Aircraft Systems) Regulations, 2020 (L.N. 42 of 2020)
- KCAA: Civil Aviation (Regulatory Fees and Charges for Unmanned Aircraft Systems) Regulations, 2020 (L.N. 4 of 2021)
- KCAA: Takardar shaidar mai gudanar da drone (Remote Air Operator Certificate, ROC)
- KCAA: Cibiyoyin horar da matuƙan drone (UTO)
- Tsarin intanet na KCAA don jiragen drone (RPAS)
- KCAA: Ƙa'idojin Sufurin Jiragen Sama na Kenya na 2026 (ƙa'idojin da aka wallafa)
Gwada yanzu: Ku buɗe shafin drone na KCAA da jadawalin kuɗaɗensa. Ku yi tebur na kowane izinin da kasuwancin da ke taswirar gonakin shayi don kuɗi zai buƙata (drone, mutane, kamfani, aiki), da shafi na inda ake nema. Ku bar kuɗaɗe a matsayin "a duba a ranar".
Yanzu za ku iya jera rajista, lasisoshi, takardun shaida da izinin Kenya da mai gudanar da drone na gona na kasuwanci zai iya buƙata, da inda ake nema.

options: Lasisin matukin drone ga mutumin da ke tuƙawa
check.why: Lasisin matukin drone (RPL) lasisi ne na mutumin da ke tuƙawa.

check.q: Kuna shirin neman izini daga KCAA wata mai zuwa da dokokin 2020. Me za ku fara dubawa?
options: Babu komai; dokokin 2020 ba sa canjawa
Ko sababbin ƙa'idojin da KCAA ta wallafa suna canja dokokin drone, da kuɗaɗen yanzu
check.why: KCAA tana jera sababbin ƙa'idojin da aka wallafa, kuma dole a duba kuɗaɗe a ranar da kuka nema.

lessons.title: Darasi 3: Najeriya: NCAA da Nig.CARs Sashe na 21
lessons.text:
Darasi 3 cikin 6 · kusan minti 6
Manufa: Rarraba drone da aiki a ƙarƙashin Sashe na 21 na Najeriya da jera abin da yake buƙata.
Wannan darasi yana shirya ku don: Idan aka ba ku nauyin drone da aikin da aka shirya a Najeriya, za ku iya rarraba drone ɗin da matakin haɗarin aikin a ƙarƙashin Sashe na 21, da jera iyakokin aiki da suka shafe shi, da rukunin nauyi da matakin haɗari daidai.
A Najeriya, Sashe na 21 (Remotely Piloted Aircraft Systems, jiragen da ake tuƙawa daga nesa) na Ƙa'idojin Sufurin Jiragen Sama na Najeriya na 2023 ne ke tafiyar da jiragen drone, takarda mai lamba Nig.CARs/2023/021, wadda ta fara aiki ranar 17 ga Mayu 2023, kuma NCAA ce ke kula da ita. Tana ɗaukar takardun shaida, rajista, ayyuka da sa ido kan RPAS.
Sashe na 21 yana rarraba jirage bisa nauyi: Nano (ƙasa da 250 g), Micro (250 g zuwa ƙasa da 2 kg), Small (2 kg zuwa ƙasa da 25 kg), Medium (25 kg zuwa 150 kg) da Large (sama da 150 kg), kowanne da sharuɗɗansa da izini na gaba daga Hukumar. Yana kuma amfani da matakan haɗarin aiki guda uku: Open (mafi ƙarancin haɗari, dole a yi rajista), Specific (haɗari mafi girma, yana buƙatar izini) da Certified (jirgi, mai gudanarwa da matuƙi duk masu takardar shaida, ana ɗaukarsa kusan kamar jirgin sama mai matuƙi). Yana tanadin lasisin matukin drone da takardun shaidar masu gudanar da RPAS.
Sashe na 21 yana kuma kafa iyakokin aiki, misali tashi a mita 120 (ƙafa 400) ko ƙasa da haka daga ƙasa a lokuta da yawa, nisan mita 30 a kwance daga mutanen da ba sa cikin aikin, rashin tashi sama da wuraren da mutane suke da yawa, da nisantar filayen jirgin sama (kamar cikin kilomita 4 daga wurin motsin jirage na filin jirgi mai sarrafawa, ko kilomita 10 don tashi na kai ko na nishaɗi) sai dai da izini. Ku karanta cikakken rubutun don sharuɗɗan da suka shafi aikinku.
Kalmomin da za ku sani:
- NCAA: Hukumar Sufurin Jiragen Sama ta Najeriya, wadda ke kula da jiragen drone a Najeriya.
- Nig.CARs: Ƙa'idojin Sufurin Jiragen Sama na Najeriya (Nigeria Civil Aviation Regulations).
- Open / Specific / Certified: matakan haɗarin aiki guda uku na Sashe na 21, daga mafi ƙarancin haɗari zuwa mafi girma.
- Wurin motsin jirage (movement area): ɓangaren filin jirgin sama da jirage ke amfani da shi don tashi, sauka da tafiya a ƙasa.
Majiyoyi na hukuma:
- Hukumar Sufurin Jiragen Sama ta Najeriya (NCAA): Nig.CARs 2023 Sashe na 21, Jiragen drone (RPAS)
Gwada yanzu: Wani kamfanin noma a Najeriya yana son yin taswirar gonakin rogo a Jihar Ogun da drone mai fikafikai da yawa (multirotor) na kg 1.2, da multirotor na kg 15 don feshi. Ta amfani da Sashe na 21, ku rubuta rukunin nauyin kowane drone, matakin haɗarin kowane aiki, da tambayoyi uku da za ku yi wa NCAA.
Yanzu za ku iya rarraba drone da aiki a ƙarƙashin Sashe na 21 na Najeriya da jera abin da yake buƙata.

check.q: A ƙarƙashin Sashe na 21, wane mataki ne ke buƙatar jirgi, mai gudanarwa da matuƙi su sami takardar shaida?
check.why: Ana ɗaukar matakin Certified kusan kamar jirgin sama mai matuƙi, da jirgi, mai gudanarwa da matuƙi masu takardar shaida.

check.q: Wani manomi a Najeriya ya nemi ku tuƙa drone mita 10 daga mutane a kasuwar ƙauye waɗanda ba sa cikin aikin. Me za ku yi?
options: Ku tuƙa da sauri ku tafi
Ku tsaya aƙalla mita 30 daga mutanen da ba sa cikin aikin, ku guji wuraren da mutane suke da yawa sai da izini
Ku ce mutanen su kau da ido
check.why: Sashe na 21 yana sa ayyuka da yawa su tsaya mita 30 daga mutanen da ba sa cikin aikin, kuma nesa da wuraren da mutane suke da yawa.

chapters.name: Babi na 2: Lasisi, takardun shaida da bin doka

lessons.title: Darasi 4: Lasisin matuƙa da takardun shaidar masu gudanarwa
lessons.text:
Darasi 4 cikin 6 · kusan minti 5
Manufa: Tsara izinin mutane da na kamfani don kasuwancin ayyukan drone.
Wannan darasi yana shirya ku don: Don kasuwancin ayyukan drone, za ku iya tsara lasisoshin matuƙa da takardar shaidar mai gudanarwa da yake buƙata, da takardun da takardar shaidar ke nema, kuna raba izinin mutumin da ke tuƙawa da izinin kasuwancin.
Iri biyu na izini suna da muhimmanci ga kasuwanci. Mutumin da ke tuƙawa yana buƙatar lasisin matuƙi da duk wani ƙarin cancanta da dokokin suke buƙata; a Kenya, lasisin matukin drone (RPL), da horo a cibiyar horo da KCAA ta amince da ita; a Najeriya, lasisin matukin drone a ƙarƙashin Sashe na 21. Ƙungiya ko kamfanin da ke sayar da ayyukan drone yawanci yana buƙatar takardar shaidar mai gudanarwa: Remote Air Operator Certificate na KCAA ko RPAS Operator Certificate na NCAA.
Takardar shaidar mai gudanarwa yawanci tana neman shaida cewa kasuwancin zai iya aiki lafiya: littafin jagorar ayyuka (yadda kuke tsarawa, tuƙawa, gyarawa da bayar da rahoto), mutanen da aka naɗa a matsayin masu alhakin aiki, matuƙa masu horo da lasisi, jiragen drone masu rajista, tsarin gyara, bayanan ajiya, da inshora. Misali, Sashe na 21 yana jera takardun shaidar inshorar abin da ya shafi wasu mutane (third-party liability) cikin takardun da dole aiki ya ɗauka.
Ku tanadi lokaci da kuɗi don wannan. Ku nemi jerin abubuwan da ake buƙata na yanzu da kuɗaɗe daga hukumar, kuma ku tambayi cibiyoyin horo da aka amince da su ko suna taimakawa da littafin jagorar ayyuka.
Mataki-mataki:
- Ku jera kowane matuƙi da lasisi da ƙarin cancantar da kowanne ke buƙata.
- Ku duba takardar shaidar mai gudanarwa da kasuwancinku ke buƙata.
- Ku karɓi jerin abubuwan neman izini na yanzu daga hukumar.
- Ku rubuta daftarin littafin jagorar ayyuka: tsarawa, tuƙawa, gyara, gaggawa, bayar da rahoto.
- Ku shirya inshora da tsarin ajiyar bayanai.
Kalmomin da za ku sani:
- Littafin jagorar ayyuka (operations manual): rubutattun dokokin kasuwanci na yadda yake tsarawa, tuƙawa, gyara jiragen drone da magance gaggawa.
- Inshorar abin da ya shafi wasu (third-party liability insurance): inshorar da ke biya idan aikinku ya cutar da wasu mutane ko kayansu.
Majiyoyi na hukuma:
- KCAA: Takardar shaidar mai gudanar da drone (Remote Air Operator Certificate, ROC)
- KCAA: Cibiyoyin horar da matuƙan drone (UTO)
- Hukumar Sufurin Jiragen Sama ta Najeriya (NCAA): Nig.CARs 2023 Sashe na 21, Jiragen drone (RPAS)
Gwada yanzu: Ku rubuta jerin abubuwan da ke ciki na littafin jagorar ayyuka don ƙaramin kasuwancin taswirar amfanin gona, da aƙalla sassa takwas (misali: ƙungiya, ayyukan kowa, tsara tashi, dubawa kafin tashi, gaggawa, gyara, bayanan ajiya, rahoton hatsari).
Yanzu za ku iya tsara lasisoshin matuƙa da takardar shaidar mai gudanarwa da kasuwancin ayyukan drone ke buƙata, da abin da littafin jagorar ayyuka ya ƙunsa.

check.q: Mece ce takardar shaidar mai gudanarwa (operator certificate)?
options: Lasisi ga mutumin da ke tuƙawa
Izini ga ƙungiya ko kamfanin da ke sayar da ayyukan drone
check.why: Takardar shaidar mai gudanarwa, kamar ROC na KCAA ko RPAS Operator Certificate na NCAA, ta kasuwanci ce.

check.q: Kuna shirin neman takardar shaidar mai gudanarwa. Wace takarda za ku fara rubutawa?
options: Littafin jagorar ayyuka don tsarawa, tuƙawa, gyara da bayar da rahoto
check.why: Neman takardar shaidar mai gudanarwa yawanci yana buƙatar littafin jagorar ayyuka da ke nuna yadda kasuwancin ke aiki lafiya.

lessons.title: Darasi 5: Ayyuka na musamman: feshi, BVLOS da filayen jirgin sama
lessons.text:
Darasi 5 cikin 6 · kusan minti 6
Manufa: Gane ayyukan da ke buƙatar ƙarin izini da waɗanda ke bayar da shi.
Wannan darasi yana shirya ku don: Idan aka ba ku aikin da ya ƙunshi feshi, BVLOS, tashi da dare ko filin jirgin sama, za ku iya gane ƙarin izinin sufurin jiragen sama da na maganin ƙwari da yake buƙata, da waɗanda ke bayar da su, kafin ku yi tayin aikin ko ku tsara shi.
Feshin maganin ƙwari ko jefa kowane abu daga drone aiki ne na musamman. Misali, Sashe na 21 ya hana jefawa ko zubar da abubuwa ta hanyar da za ta jawo haɗari, kuma yana da dokoki na daban don kaya masu haɗari, kuma jadawalin kuɗaɗe na Kenya yana jera izini na daban don matakan haɗari mafi girma. Ana ɗaukar magungunan ƙwari da yawa a matsayin kaya masu haɗari. Ku sa ran za ku buƙaci izinin sufurin jiragen sama na musamman, jirgi mai nauyi mai takardar shaida, da ma'aikata masu horo.
Feshi yana kuma ƙarƙashin dokar maganin ƙwari. A Kenya, Pest Control Products Board (PCPB) ce ke kula da magungunan ƙwari; a Najeriya, NAFDAC ce ke kula da sinadaran noma. Ku tambaye su ko za a iya feshin maganin daga sama, da irin horo da kayan kariya da masu feshi ke buƙata. FAO da WHO sun wallafa jagora kan feshin maganin ƙwari daga sama. Kada ku taɓa yin feshi, ko yin tayin feshi, ba tare da izinin sufurin jiragen sama DA na maganin ƙwari ba.
Sauran ayyuka na musamman sun haɗa da tashi wuce gani (BVLOS), tashi da dare, kusa da filin jirgin sama ko a cikinsa, sama da mutane ko hanyoyi, da a wuraren da aka hana ko aka kare kamar wuraren shaƙatawa na ƙasa (national parks). Kowanne yana buƙatar izini na musamman. Manyan gonaki kusa da ƙananan filayen jirgi sun zama ruwan dare a Afirka: ku duba nisan, ku tambaya kafin ku tsara aiki.
Kalmomin da za ku sani:
- Kaya masu haɗari (dangerous goods): abubuwan da za su iya cutar da lafiya, tsaro ko dukiya lokacin jigilarsu, kamar magungunan ƙwari da yawa.
- Mai kula da maganin ƙwari: hukumar gwamnati da ke yin rajistar magungunan ƙwari da sarrafa yadda ake amfani da su.
- BVLOS: beyond visual line of sight: tashi wuce inda idanunku ke iya ganin drone ɗin.
Majiyoyi na hukuma:
- Hukumar Sufurin Jiragen Sama ta Najeriya (NCAA): Nig.CARs 2023 Sashe na 21, Jiragen drone (RPAS)
- KCAA: Civil Aviation (Regulatory Fees and Charges for Unmanned Aircraft Systems) Regulations, 2020 (L.N. 4 of 2021)
- Hukumar Kula da Magungunan Ƙwari ta Kenya (Pest Control Products Board, PCPB)
- Hukumar Kula da Abinci da Magunguna ta Ƙasa (NAFDAC, Najeriya)
- FAO da WHO: Jagora kan feshin maganin ƙwari daga sama (2024)
Gwada yanzu: Wata babbar gonar rake mai nisan kilomita 3 daga ƙaramin filin jirgi ta nemi ku yi feshin maganin fungus (fungicide) da drone. Ku jera kowane izini da dubawa da za ku buƙata (sufurin jiragen sama, maganin ƙwari, mai filin, filin jirgin sama) da wanda za ku tuntuɓa don kowanne.
Yanzu za ku iya gane ayyuka na musamman da jera izinin sufurin jiragen sama da na maganin ƙwari da suke buƙata.

check.q: Wace hukuma ce ke kula da sinadaran noma a Najeriya?
check.why: A Najeriya, NAFDAC ce ke kula da sinadaran noma; izinin sufurin jiragen sama daga NCAA yake.

check.q: Wata babbar gona ta nemi ku yi feshin maganin fungus da drone mako mai zuwa. Lasisin matuƙi kawai kuke da shi. Me za ku yi?
options: Kada ku yi tayin feshi har sai kun sami izinin sufurin jiragen sama da na maganin ƙwari duka biyu
Ku yi feshi da sassafe lokacin da babu kowa
Ku yi feshi a rabin gonar kawai
Ku yi amfani da drone mai sauƙi ku yi feshi duk da haka
check.why: Feshi yana buƙatar izinin sufurin jiragen sama na musamman da izinin maganin ƙwari; kada ku taɓa yin feshi ba tare da duka biyun ba.

lessons.title: Darasi 6: Gina fayil na bin doka da kula da shi
lessons.text:
Darasi 6 cikin 6 · kusan minti 5
Manufa: Gina fayil na bin doka da jadawalin da zai sa ya kasance na zamani.
Wannan darasi yana shirya ku don: Don kasuwancin drone ɗinku, za ku iya gina fayil na bin doka da jadawalin sabuntawa da duba dokoki, da kowace takarda da ake buƙata a jere da matsayinta.
Fayil na bin doka yana ɗauke da duk abin da ke tabbatar da cewa aikinku yana bisa doka kuma lafiya, a wuri ɗaya da za ku iya nuna wa mai duba, abokin ciniki ko kamfanin inshora. Ku ajiye kwafi a takarda da kwafin intanet da aka yi ajiyarsa (backup).
Ku saka: ƙa'idoji da ma'aunan da kuke bi (da ranakun da kuka duba); takardun shaidar rajistar kowane drone; takardun izinin shigo da kaya; lasisin matuƙa da ƙarin cancanta; takardar shaidar mai gudanarwa; izinin ayyuka; littafin jagorar ayyuka; takardun shaidar inshora; bayanan gyara; bayanan tashi (flight logs); rahotannin hatsari; yarjejeniyoyi da abokan ciniki da izinin masu fili; da matakan kare bayananku (Kenya: ODPC; Najeriya: NDPC) idan kuna ajiye bayanan sirri na manoma.
Dokoki, kuɗaɗe da fom suna canjawa. Ku riƙe kalandar sabuntawa don kowane lasisi da takardar shaida, kuma ku duba shafin hukumar a kan jadawali ƙayyadadde, misali kowane wata, da kafin kowane sabon nau'in aiki. Ku rubuta abin da kuka duba da lokacin.
Mataki-mataki:
- Ku ƙirƙiri fayil ɗin: takarda da na intanet da aka yi ajiyarsa.
- Ku saka ƙa'idoji, takardun shaida, lasisoshi, izini, littafin jagora, inshora.
- Ku saka bayanan gyara, bayanan tashi, rahotannin hatsari, yarjejeniyoyi.
- Ku saka rajistar kare bayanai ko matakai idan kuna ajiye bayanan sirri.
- Ku kafa kalandar sabuntawa da duba dokoki kowane wata.
Kalmomin da za ku sani:
- Bin doka (compliance): bin dokoki da ƙa'idojin da suka shafe ku.
- Sabuntawa (renewal): sake nema kafin lasisi ko takardar shaida ta ƙare.
Majiyoyi na hukuma:
- Hukumar Sufurin Jiragen Sama ta Kenya (KCAA): Jiragen sama marasa matuƙi (UAS)
- KCAA: Ƙa'idojin Sufurin Jiragen Sama na Kenya na 2026 (ƙa'idojin da aka wallafa)
- Hukumar Sufurin Jiragen Sama ta Najeriya (NCAA): Nig.CARs 2023 Sashe na 21, Jiragen drone (RPAS)
- Ofishin Kwamishinan Kare Bayanai (ODPC, Kenya)
- Hukumar Kare Bayanai ta Najeriya (NDPC)
Gwada yanzu: Aikin ƙarshe: ku gina fayil na bin doka don kasuwancin ayyukan drone a ƙasarku: hukuma da ƙa'idoji da ranaku, rukuni da matakin haɗari, kowane izini da matsayinsa, takardun da ake buƙata, ƙarin izinin feshi idan an shirya, matakan kare bayanai, da kalandar sabuntawa da duba dokoki.
Yanzu za ku iya gina fayil na bin doka da kula da shi wanda ke nuna cewa aikin drone ɗinku yana bisa doka kuma lafiya.
Yadda ake duba aikinku na ƙarshe:
Abin da muke dubawa Har yanzu bai kai ba Ya cika Ya wuce Hukuma da ƙa'idoji Babu hukumar ko ƙa'idojin, ko babu hanyoyin haɗi ko ranaku. An jera hukumar, ƙa'idoji, ma'aunai da jadawalin kuɗaɗe da hanyoyin haɗi da ranar da aka duba. Ya kuma rubuta duk wasu sababbin dokokin da aka wallafa da yadda suke canja aikin. Rukuni da haɗari Babu rukunin drone ko matakin haɗarin aikin, ko ba daidai ba ne. Rukunin drone da matakin haɗarin aikin daidai ne bisa dokokin ƙasar. Ya jera iyakokin aiki da suka shafe shi, kamar tsayi da nisa daga mutane. Izinin da ake buƙata Akwai izinin da ba a saka ba, ko ba a faɗi wanda ke bayar da su ba. An jera kowace rajista, takardar izini, lasisi, takardar shaida da izini da wanda ke bayar da ita da matsayinta. Ya haɗa da kuɗaɗen yanzu da jadawalin lokacin samun kowanne. Takardun mutane da na kasuwanci Babu littafin jagorar ayyuka, inshora ko bayanan ajiya. An jera lasisin matuƙa, takardar shaidar mai gudanarwa, littafin jagorar ayyuka, inshora, bayanan gyara da na tashi. Ya faɗi sunayen masu alhakin aiki da inda ake ajiye kowace takarda. Feshi da ayyuka na musamman An tsara feshi ko wasu ayyuka na musamman ba tare da ƙarin izini ba. An jera ƙarin izinin sufurin jiragen sama da na maganin ƙwari don kowane aiki na musamman da waɗanda ke bayar da su. Ya bayyana yadda nisa daga filin jirgin sama da dokokin kaya masu haɗari suke shafar aikin. Kasancewa na zamani Babu ranakun sabuntawa ko jadawalin duba dokoki; babu matakan kare bayanai. Akwai kalandar sabuntawa, jadawali ƙayyadadde na duba dokoki, da matakan kare bayanan manoma. Yana da littafin bayanai da ke nuna dubawar da ta gabata da abin da ya canja. Don cin nasara: "Ya cika" ko "Ya wuce" a kowane layi. Idan wani layi "Bai kai ba tukuna", ku gyara wannan sashe na fayil ɗin ku sake duba shi.

check.q: Me ke shiga fayil na bin doka?
options: Hotunan tashin da ya gabata kawai
Lasisoshi, takardun shaida, izini, littafin jagorar ayyuka, inshora da bayanan ajiya
check.why: Fayil na bin doka yana ɗauke da duk abin da ke tabbatar da cewa aikinku yana bisa doka kuma lafiya.

check.q: Lasisin matukin drone ɗinku zai ƙare cikin watanni uku. Me zai hana ku manta?
options: Kalandar sabuntawa mai ranar kowane lasisi da takardar shaida
Dubawa kawai idan abokin ciniki ya tambaya
Ajiye lasisin a cikin akwatin drone
check.why: Kalandar sabuntawa da dubawa a kan jadawali suna sa kowane lasisi da takardar shaida su kasance na zamani.
